description: Header file defining utility functions and classes for autograd tensor operations in PyTorch, including output wrapping, input checking, gradient requirement computation, and gradient history setting.

classes.name: ComputeRequiresGrad
classes.description: A helper struct to determine if any input tensor requires gradient computation.

methods.name: wrap_outputs
methods.description: Wraps tensor outputs in variables, creating grad_fn if necessary.

methods.name: check_input_variables
methods.description: Checks that input variables meet specified criteria.

methods.name: compute_requires_grad
methods.description: Determines if any of the provided tensors require gradients.

methods.name: set_history
methods.description: Sets the gradient history for tensors or variables.

methods.name: isFwGradDefined
methods.description: Checks if the forward gradient is defined for a tensor.

methods.name: isFwGradDefinedTensorList
methods.description: Checks if forward gradients are defined for a list of tensors.
